# Wharf 0.8.0 implementation review

## Status

Implementation is validated for release.

## Findings

- Requested and effective CLI versions must match exactly before an invocation
  is returned.
- Native effort and normalized frontier effort are both retained.
- Environment, file, and stdin credential sources expose only source metadata;
  stdin source references and synthetic credential values do not appear in
  arguments, environment values, or redacted commands.
- Endpoints require HTTPS and an explicit host allowlist.
- Version probing reads stdout and stderr concurrently and reports non-zero
  exits explicitly.
- Full task execution and patch capture remain deferred to Session 9.

## Validation evidence

Formatting verification, Release build, and the complete suite passed all 47
tests with zero warnings or errors.
